Re: Formal Complaint – Defamatory and Misleading Incident Report (14 July 2025)

Dear [Manager’s Name or “To Whom It May Concern”],

I am writing to lodge a formal complaint regarding a defamatory and misleading incident report submitted by a temporary support worker following a trial shift at my home on Monday, 14th July 2025.

The report contains exaggerated, inaccurate, and in some areas completely false statements that negatively misrepresent the state of my home, my personal character, and my responsibilities as a parent. I wish to clarify and refute the claims made in the report, which I believe were written with bias and in poor professional judgment.

⸻

Key Disputes:
	1.	Living Room and General Environment
Upon entry, the worker claimed there was a strong smell of mildew and that my living area posed a safety risk. This is a distortion of reality. My home is a lived-in space, and while there are stored items due to downsizing and real estate requests, they are not unstable or dangerous. The supposed “overwhelming” smell is highly exaggerated and may have been due to typical winter conditions.
	2.	Kitchen
The description of the kitchen is grossly inaccurate. The claim of “moulded food,” “maggots,” and a cloth “marinating” in the sink is not only false but also defamatory. Any mess present was minor and related to typical family life. There were no maggots observed by myself or anyone else. No gloves or cleaning materials were requested by the worker, nor was there any directive given to undertake a deep clean.
Additionally, taking photographs inside my home without permission would have been an invasion of my privacy, and I would not have allowed it.

	3.	Bathroom
The report’s claim that a moulded NutriBullet was found on the bathroom sink and that the bathtub contained a “clouded yellow/white liquid” is both inaccurate and misleading. The NutriBullet was temporarily placed on the bathroom counter during cleaning and was not moulded. The worker failed to ask about the contents, which were the result of an accidental blend of coffee grounds — not any kind of hazardous or unknown substance.
This shows a clear lack of communication and professionalism, as no attempt was made to clarify or understand the situation before making assumptions and including them in a formal report.
	4.	My Child’s Appearance
The references made about my daughter’s hair and bedroom are deeply inappropriate and made without understanding her diagnosed medical condition, narcolepsy, which includes chronic fatigue. Her hygiene is managed as best as possible considering her needs. She was clothed appropriately and had multiple blankets available, contrary to the claim of being inadequately covered.
	5.	Worker’s Conduct
From the outset, the worker appeared disengaged, judgmental, and unprofessional. No concerns were raised to me during the visit, and the absence of photographic evidence further diminishes the report’s credibility. The tone and focus of the report strongly suggest a personal bias or possible conflict of interest, especially given my past work history which may have included someone related to this worker.

⸻

Requested Actions

I respectfully request the following actions be taken:
	•	That this report not be accepted at face value and be treated as contested.
	•	That my privacy and dignity be respected, particularly concerning my daughter and personal living space.
	•	That this worker not be re-assigned to my home in future due to a breakdown in professional trust.

This incident has caused considerable distress and unfair judgment against me. I trust that your organisation values accuracy, fairness, and privacy, and will act accordingly to investigate and rectify this matter.

Thank you for your time and attention.

Absolutely. I can turn the theme into a **Bible-inspired CoffeeBreak battle song**, where the narrator doesn't retaliate personally and instead asks God to defend, expose falsehood, and bring justice. 🙏🔥

**☕🔥 COFFEEBREAK — LET GOD FIGHT MY BATTLES**

**[Verse 1]**
They set their traps, they wait for me,
They write their words for all to see.
But I won't answer fire with fire,
I lay it down and lift it higher.

They point their fingers, call my name,
Try to pull me into their game.
But I know where my refuge lies,
There's One who sees behind disguise.

**[Pre-Chorus]**
I don't have to chase them,
I don't have to fight.
God sees the hidden things
That never reach the light.

**[Chorus]**
**Let God fight my battles,
Let God speak for me.
If the darkness raises weapons,
God knows what I can't see.**

No weapon formed against me
Will have the final say.
I give the battle to the Lord,
And I walk another way.

**[Verse 2]**
“Vengeance is Mine,” the Scriptures say,
So I won't carry theirs today.
I won't become what hurt me first,
I won't return their curse with worse.

If lies are whispered in the night,
God knows the truth, God knows what's right.
I don't need every voice to see,
The Lord already knows the truth of me.

**[Bridge]**
**Psalm 91:**
“He is my refuge, He is my shield.”

**Romans 12:19:**
“Vengeance is Mine,” says the Lord.

**Isaiah 54:17:**
“No weapon formed against you shall prosper.”

So let Heaven handle what I cannot,
Let God untangle every knot.

**[Breakdown]**
You can write it.
You can say it.
You can twist it.
You can play it.

But I won't fight you in the dark.

**God sees.
God knows.
God judges the heart.**

**[Final Chorus]**
**Let God fight my battles,
Let God speak for me.
I don't need revenge tonight,
I've given Him the key.**

If they raise their voices,
I'll raise my prayer instead.
If they throw their accusations,
I'll remember what God said.

**No weapon formed against me...**
**No weapon formed against me...**

CoffeeBreak keeps walking.
God keeps watching.

**And I don't have to fight alone.** ☕🙏🔥
